title: Pure P series
summary: Pure :P series cyberpunk heist Link deck, capturing the partnership and rivalry between I:P Masquerena and S:P Little Knight (Chiyomaru) alongside EM:P Meowmine and W:P Fancy Ball. The deck pairs Level 2 Cyberse and Spright engines to field I:P Masquerena and Level 2 extenders, Quick-Linking into S:P Little Knight, W:P Fancy Ball, or Underworld Goddess of the Closed World on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Starters
points: Live☆Twin Ki-sikil (and Live☆Twin Sunny's Snitch / Cynet Mining) Special Summons Lil-la from the Deck, establishing a 1-card Link-2 to summon I:P Masquerena and trigger EM:P Meowmine.
Spright Starter Special Summons Spright Blue or Spright Jet straight from the Deck, initiating Spright searches without using a Normal Summon.
Spright Blue and Spright Jet Special Summon themselves while you control any Level 2 or Link-2 monster, tutoring the entire Spright engine.

EM:P Meowmine Special Summons itself from the hand while any Link Monster is on the field or in either GY, and banishes itself from the GY to bounce a card when a Link-2 or higher monster's effect activates.

summary.title: Opening: Live☆Twin Ki-sikil + Spright Blue
steps: Normal Summon Live☆Twin Ki-sikil, triggering its effect to Special Summon Live☆Twin Lil-la from your Deck.
Special Summon Spright Blue from your hand, searching Spright Jet from your Deck.
Special Summon Spright Jet from your hand, searching Spright Starter.
Overlay Ki-sikil and Lil-la into Gigantic Spright, detaching a material to Special Summon EM:P Meowmine from your Deck.
Link Spright Blue and Spright Jet into I:P Masquerena.

Pass turn with I:P Masquerena, Gigantic Spright, and EM:P Meowmine on the board, ready to Quick-Link on the opponent's turn into S:P Little Knight or W:P Fancy Ball while triggering Meowmine's GY bounce.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: I:P Masquerena Link Summons during the opponent's Main Phase as a Quick Effect, conferring effect-destruction immunity to the summoned Link Monster.
S:P Little Knight banishes a card on the field or in the GY if summoned using an Extra Deck monster, and banishes two face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.

W:P Fancy Ball banishes itself as a Quick Effect if summoned that turn to negate and banish an opponent's monster effect, and can Link Summon during the opponent's Main Phase using an opponent's Link-2 or lower monster as material.
Mekk-Knight Crusadia Avramax gains destruction immunity from I:P Masquerena, cannot be targeted by card effects, and gains ATK equal to the opponent's Special Summoned monster during battle.
Underworld Goddess of the Closed World uses an opponent's monster as Link Material, negates all face-up opponent monsters on summon, and negates GY effects as a Quick Effect.
Spright Red and Spright Carrot Tribute a Level 2 or Link-2 monster to negate monster effects or Spells/Traps.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Spright Starter provides instant Level 2 board presence and searches without spending a Normal Summon.
Live☆Twin Sunny's Snitch and Cynet Mining guarantee consistent access to 1-card starters.
S-Force Chase bounces opponent face-up cards based on your S-Force monsters.
Vivid Tail bounces a card you control as a Quick Effect to set itself back.

allow.Spright Blue: Level 2 DARK Thunder extender that Special Summons itself while you control Level 2 EM:P Meowmine or a Link-2 (I:P Masquerena or S:P Little Knight!) and searches Spright Jet.
allow.Spright Jet: Level 2 DARK Thunder that Special Summons itself alongside EM:P Meowmine or I:P Masquerena and searches Spright Starter.
allow.Spright Red: Level 2 FIRE Thunder that tributes a Level 2 or Link-2 to negate monster effects while fueling I:P Masquerena's Quick-Link.
allow.Spright Carrot: Level 2 FIRE Thunder that tributes a Level 2 or Link-2 to negate Spell/Trap activations.
allow.Spright Starter: Quick-Play Spell that Special Summons any Level 2 Spright from the Deck to assemble I:P Masquerena + EM:P Meowmine.
allow.Live☆Twin Ki-sikil: Level 2 Cyberse 1-card starter that summons Lil-la from the Deck to immediately put a Link-2 on the board (unlocking EM:P Meowmine in your hand!) and fuel I:P Masquerena -> W:P Fancy Ball.
allow.Live☆Twin Lil-la: Level 2 Cyberse 1-card starter that summons Ki-sikil from the Deck for 1-card I:P Masquerena + EM:P Meowmine setups.
allow.Live☆Twin Sunny's Snitch: Continuous Spell that searches Live☆Twin Ki-sikil or Lil-la to guarantee 1-card access to I:P Masquerena, S:P Little Knight, and W:P Fancy Ball.
allow.Cynet Mining: Discards 1 card to search Level 2 Cyberse EM:P Meowmine, Live☆Twin Ki-sikil, or Live☆Twin Lil-la directly from your Deck.
allow.Gigantic Spright: Rank 2 Xyz that Special Summons any Level 2 monster (including EM:P Meowmine or S-Force Rappa Chiyomaru!) directly from your Deck!

main: EM:P Meowmine
